features.name: Questionnaire-driven trial personalization
features.description: Partners can create questionnaires on their websites to profile prospects and pass that information to Business Central to automatically load relevant apps and configure the trial experience.

features.name: App loading based on prospect profile
features.description: Business Central can dynamically load AppSource apps based on the answers captured in the partner's questionnaire, allowing partners to serve different solutions to different customer segments.
caveats: Requires partner to configure which apps load for which profile combinations

features.name: System table for questionnaire data storage
features.description: Business Central stores questionnaire answers in a system table that is available before sign-in, allowing apps to pivot the experience based on prospect profiles.

features.name: Embedded CSP buying experience
features.description: Partners can build an embedded buying experience within the trial that handles the CSP relationship setup and takes customers through onboarding in their own company.

features.name: Onboarding checklist framework
features.description: Partners can create onboarding checklists with various elements like videos, tasks, banners and role center items bundled into AppSource apps to guide customers through setup.
caveats: Checklists are examples for inspiration, not prescriptive
users can move and navigate freely, potentially skipping tasks or changing order
designed for five to seven items maximum

features.name: Cohesive single-experience trial launch
features.description: From the user perspective, the standard trial plus partner app and questionnaire context appears as one coherent experience without revealing the technical composition.

features.name: Context-aware app loading from questionnaire
features.description: Apps and dependencies are automatically loaded into the trial environment based on user responses to a pre-signup questionnaire about their business context and previous systems used.

features.name: Onboarding checklist with multiple element types
features.description: A customizable checklist used to guide prospects through onboarding with videos, setup steps, data imports, feature highlights, and links to external resources.
caveats: Users can navigate freely and skip tasks

features.name: Assisted setup with filtering by category
features.description: The assisted setup list page can be filtered and called from checklist tasks to present focused setup steps and data import scenarios to users.

features.name: Spotlight tour for Excel integration
features.description: Spotlight tours highlight core integrations like Excel edit-in-place and Teams sharing capabilities for custom entities to generate excitement about Business Central features.

features.name: Report request page teaching tips
features.description: Teaching tips appear on report request pages to educate users about the report purpose, best practices, and filtering options before running the report.

features.name: Excel-based report layouts
features.description: Partners can provide Excel layouts for reports that display data dynamically and include charts. The data set updates automatically when the report is printed.

features.name: Teaching tips with markdown and links
features.description: Teaching tips support markdown formatting for bold and italics, and can include hyperlinks to other pages to guide users through navigation.

features.name: Analysis mode with teaching tips
features.description: Queries can be opened in analysis mode from pages, and teaching tips can educate users about the analysis content and insights displayed.

features.name: Analysis sharing and copying
features.description: Users can duplicate analyses, rename them, and copy links to specific analysis views to share with colleagues via Teams or other channels.

features.name: Onboarding sample app on GitHub
features.description: A sample app is available on GitHub that demonstrates onboarding patterns and can be forked as a template for building custom onboarding experiences.

features.name: Custom role center loading with user context
features.description: Partners can load a custom role center and attach it to a role before users sign in, enabling context-aware entry points based on questionnaire responses.

features.name: Welcome banner text customization
features.description: The welcome banner text on the role center can be customized via events to greet users with relevant content matching their business context.

features.name: Assisted setup function call with filtering
features.description: The open assisted setup function in guide experience items can be called to open the assisted setup list filtered to a custom category.

features.name: Just-in-time data loading with clarification
features.description: Assisted setups can ask users clarifying questions to determine which data to load, enabling selective imports based on customer needs and preferences.

features.name: Minute indicator on checklist tasks
features.description: Checklist tasks can display time estimates to help manage user expectations about task duration during trial and evaluation scenarios.

features.name: Banner welcome message on role center
features.description: A banner that greets users at the role center entrance to get started. Should keep welcome message short and clear with a call to action.

features.name: Onboarding checklist
features.description: A checklist shown in the banner that provides overview and structure of relevant activities, guiding users through discovering key values in Business Central. Users can navigate freely and skip tasks.
caveats: users can move and navigate freely, potentially skipping tasks or changing order
designed for five to seven items maximum

features.name: Evaluation and trial checklists
features.description: Shorter checklists designed for evaluation and trial periods with minimal friction. Include minute indicators for each task to show time commitment. Mix of videos, Spotlight tools, and other content types.
caveats: must be short with minimal friction
users have limited patience and time

features.name: Go-live checklists
features.description: Role-oriented checklists for go-live situations focused on setting up Business Central for doing work. Can include more involved setup tasks related to user permissions. Should preconfig as much as possible.
caveats: should be role-oriented and not show irrelevant tasks
keep setup short and preconfig as much as possible

features.name: Assisted setup list
features.description: A guided list used to wrap up checklist items when there are more than seven items. Provides an alternative to lengthy checklists for guiding users through setup.

features.name: Spotlight tours
features.description: Pattern for showing key features like Teams and Excel integration. Allows users to discover features and try them out in two steps. Can be placed on relevant pages with introduction text explaining value.
caveats: currently focused on Teams and Excel features

features.name: Teaching tips
features.description: UI elements that point to particular actions or fields on a page with explanations. Sequenced by top-to-bottom order on the page. Should focus on three most important elements with brief explanations.
caveats: users may skip if too many

features.name: Actionable errors
features.description: Improved error handling that provides actionable errors at the field level. Allows users to unblock themselves in context through actions like refreshing the page or accepting recommended actions.

features.name: Signup context and website profiling
features.description: Capability to profile website visitors and pass signup context data when they transition to Business Central. Allows matching customers with appropriate onboarding solutions based on their profile.

features.name: Application Insights telemetry
features.description: Integration with Application Insights for tracking telemetry in onboarding implementations. Recommended for partners to track usage and support proactive assistance for customers.
